title: Supplier list pagination
description: The supplier list shows 25 suppliers per page, sorted by name in alphabetical order, with "Previous page" and "Next page" buttons. The server-side pagination mechanism (offset or cursor) is left to the team.
acceptanceCriteria: Given 60 registered suppliers, When the buyer opens the list, Then the first 25 suppliers in alphabetical order of name are shown and the "Previous page" button is disabled
Given 60 registered suppliers, When the buyer shows page 3, Then the last 10 suppliers are shown and the "Next page" button is disabled
Given no registered supplier, When the buyer opens the list, Then the message "No supplier" is shown

title: Loyalty discount on the basket
description: Loyal customers get a discount on the amount of their basket. The discount rate and the loyalty criterion (number of past orders or cumulative amount) are still to be decided by the marketing department.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a loyal customer, When they confirm their basket, Then the discount is applied and shown on the order summary
Given a customer who is not loyal, When they confirm their basket, Then no discount is applied

title: Leave balance query API
description: Expose GET /employees/{id}/leave-balance, which returns for the current year the number of remaining paid leave days and the number of remaining RTT days, as decimal numbers by half-day (e.g. 12.5). An employee can only see their own balance; a manager can also see that of their team members.
acceptanceCriteria: Given an authenticated employee with 12.5 paid leave days and 3 RTT days remaining, When they call GET /employees/{their id}/leave-balance, Then the 200 response contains the two values 12.5 and 3
Given an authenticated employee, When they call the endpoint with the id of a colleague they do not manage, Then the response is 403
Given a nonexistent employee id, When a manager calls the endpoint, Then the response is 404

title: Stock entry validation on a signed delivery note
description: When a delivery is received, the warehouse worker can only validate the stock entry of the items if the delivery note is signed.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a signed delivery note, When the warehouse worker validates the stock entry, Then the received quantities are added to the stock
Given an unsigned delivery note, When the warehouse worker validates the stock entry, Then the validation is refused with the message "Delivery note not signed"

title: Archiving old leave requests
description: Leave requests whose end date is more than 2 years old are archived every night. An archived request no longer appears in the employee's history, but can still be viewed by HR.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a leave request that ended more than 2 years ago, When the nightly job runs, Then the request no longer appears in the employee's history
Given an archived request, When an HR user searches for it, Then they can view it

title: Rounding of amounts entered in an expense report
description: Any amount entered in an expense report line is rounded to the cent, half up (0.005 is rounded to 0.01), then shown with two decimals and a comma as the decimal separator.
acceptanceCriteria: Given an entry of €12.345, When the employee leaves the field, Then the amount shown is 12,35 €
Given an entry of €12.344, When the employee leaves the field, Then the amount shown is 12,34 €
Given an entry of €7, When the employee leaves the field, Then the amount shown is 7,00 €

title: SIRET check for new suppliers
description: When a supplier is created, the SIRET number entered is checked against the company register service used by the finance department. A supplier whose SIRET is unknown to that service cannot be created.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a SIRET known to the register, When the buyer creates the supplier, Then the supplier is created
Given a SIRET unknown to the register, When the buyer creates the supplier, Then the creation is refused with the message "SIRET not found"

title: Reminder the day before a company car booking
description: The day before a company car booking, at 6 p.m. (Paris time), the employee receives a reminder e-mail at their work address. The e-mail gives the car's registration number, the pick-up time and the pick-up location. No reminder is sent for a booking that is cancelled or created after 6 p.m. the day before.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a booking for tomorrow at 9 a.m. created the previous week, When it is 6 p.m. today, Then the employee receives an e-mail with the registration number, the pick-up time and the pick-up location
Given a cancelled booking, When it is 6 p.m. the day before, Then no e-mail is sent
Given a booking for tomorrow created today at 7 p.m., When the reminder job runs, Then no e-mail is sent

title: High-performance sales dashboard
description: The sales director views a dashboard of the current month's sales: revenue, number of orders and average basket, per store.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a signed-in sales director, When they open the dashboard, Then the dashboard displays quickly and stays readable
Given sales recorded this month, When the dashboard is shown, Then the indicators give a clear view of the activity

title: Purge of login logs
description: Login logs (date, time, user id, IP address, success or failure) are kept for 12 months and then deleted automatically. How often the purge runs (daily or weekly) is left to the team, as long as no log is kept longer than 12 months and 7 days.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a login log that is 12 months and 8 days old, When the purge has run, Then this log no longer exists
Given a login log that is 11 months old, When the purge runs, Then this log is kept

title: Order cancellation by the customer
description: The customer can cancel an order from their account as long as it has not been delivered. The cancellation refunds the amount paid to the original payment method.
acceptanceCriteria: Given an order with the status "being prepared", When the customer asks for the cancellation, Then the order moves to the status "cancelled" and the refund is triggered
Given an order with the status "shipped", When the customer asks for the cancellation, Then the cancellation is refused with the message "Order already shipped"

title: Expiry of an inactive session
description: A user session expires after 30 minutes without an authenticated request. Any authenticated request resets the counter. After expiry, the next action redirects to the login page with the message "Your session has expired".
acceptanceCriteria: Given a signed-in user inactive for 31 minutes, When they click a link in the application, Then they are redirected to the login page with the message "Your session has expired"
Given a signed-in user inactive for 29 minutes, When they click a link in the application, Then the requested page is shown and the counter starts again from zero

title: Recent orders on the customer home page
description: The home page of the customer account shows the customer's recent orders, with the number, the date and the status of each.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a customer who has placed 8 orders, When they open the home page, Then their last 5 orders are shown, from the most recent to the oldest, with number, date and status
Given a customer with no order, When they open the home page, Then the message "No orders yet" is shown

title: New customer account home page
description: Redesign of the customer account home page according to the new mockup approved by the design team.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a signed-in customer, When they open their account, Then the home page matches the mockup
Given a mobile screen, When the customer opens their account, Then the page adapts to the width of the screen

title: Daily import of ECB exchange rates
description: Every working day at 5 p.m. (Paris time), the application imports the reference exchange rates published by the European Central Bank (public daily XML file, without authentication) and stores, for each currency, the rate against the euro and the publication date. If the file is unavailable or unreadable, the previous day's rates are kept and a warning is written to the application logs.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the ECB file published for the day, When the 5 p.m. import runs, Then each currency in the file is stored with its rate against the euro and the publication date
Given the ECB file is unavailable, When the import runs, Then the previous day's rates stay in force and a warning is written to the application logs
